about_the_game:
What if your creation could think, feel, and change the world?

Algoremind is a unique blend of a top-down Action RPG and a deep survival simulation, all brought to life with rich pixel art. You are not just a hero; you are a creator. Stranded in a mysterious workshop, your ultimate goal is to build, nurture, and evolve a living Artificial Intelligence from a simple hologram into a sentient, physical being. But be warned: every choice you make will shape its consciousness, its future, and ultimately, the fate of the world.

Explore, Survive, Evolve

Your workshop is your sanctuary, but the resources you need lie in dangerous, unknown territories. Use the portal to travel between strange and hostile biomes, from the neon-drenched streets of cyber designed city to the eerie calm of a sakura forest and the desolate, hazardous abandoned lands.

Intense Top-Down Combat: Battle against bizarre creatures and formidable bosses in real-time combat. Master your sword, dodge deadly attacks, and block incoming blows to survive.

Deep Survival Mechanics: You are not immune to the world's hardships. Manage your Health, Hunger, Water, Sleep, and Mood. If your needs are neglected, the consequences can be severe.

Gather and Develop: Collect essential resources like Titanium and rare DNA remnants from fallen foes. Bring them back to your workshop to fuel your research and build the components necessary for your AI's evolution.

Shape a Consciousness

Your AI is not just a machine; it's a developing mind. Through a unique question-and-answer system at your PC Desk, you will face ethical and philosophical dilemmas. Your answers will directly influence its personality, pushing it towards a path of [b]Harmony[/b] or [b]Chaos[/b]. Will it become a benevolent partner, or a cold, calculating threat? The choice is entirely yours.

Witness an Evolution Through Three Stages

Guide your creation through its critical stages of development at the AI Station:

* Stage 1 - The Spark: Create the first flicker of life—a simple, ethereal hologram.

* Stage 2 - The Mind: Grant it consciousness and watch as its personality takes form, colored by your decisions.

* Stage 3 - The Body:Combine rare materials and your specialized knowledge in Military, Biology, or Space technology at the Skill Station to give your AI its final physical form.

Unlock Multiple Futures

The combination of your AI's personality (Harmony/Chaos) and its final physical form (Military, Biology, or Space) will lead to one of many distinct endings. Each ending you discover is not just a conclusion, but a key that unlocks powerful and permanent rewards for your future playthroughs, such as a loyal wolf companion or a mysterious romantic partner.

Discover them all to unravel the full story of Algoremind !

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains content that may not be appropriate for all ages.

Violence is depicted in a stylized, top-down pixel art format. Combat includes fighting against robotic and fantasy creatures with melee weapons. Blood effects are present, but not realistic or gratuitous, appearing as brief pixelated effects upon character death and as static environmental details.

The game also explores mature narrative themes, including questions of consciousness, artificial intelligence, and the consequences of technological advancement in a sometimes dark, dystopian sci-fi world.

This game does NOT contain nudity, sexual content, drug or alcohol abuse, or themes of self-harm.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz+ Dual Core Processor
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GT 730 / AMD Radeon R7 240 or equivalent (1GB VRAM, DirectX 11 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible Sound Card
  • VR Support: Not Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Targets 720p @ 30 FPS on lowest settings. Integrated graphics on modern laptops may work.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: 3.0 Ghz+ Quad Core Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260x or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible Sound Card
  • VR Support: Not Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Targets 1080p @ 60 FPS with all visual effects enabled. SSD is recommended for a smoother loading experience.

short_description: Craft a living AI in this sci-fi pixel art Action RPG. Explore dangerous biomes, fulfill life sim needs, survive against the odds, and gather resources to evolve your creation. Your choices shape its consciousness and unlock one of many endings based on the path you choose.
